info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Card Transaction Switch Review-spec
info.description: The Card Transaction Switch Review API allows users to initiate and submit reviews for card transaction switches. This endpoint is designed for banking operational services, facilitating the evaluation of transaction processes to enhance oversight and compliance. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial service providers looking to streamline their transaction monitoring and review operations. It ensures that each transaction switch is thoroughly assessed for accuracy and compliance, promoting more secure banking practices.

post.summary: Submit a review for a specific card transaction.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a review pertaining to a specific card transaction identified by CARD-400045. Reviews help in collecting feedback to improve transaction processing and customer satisfaction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a review for the specified card transaction. It should contain all necessary information as outlined in the schema, which includes details such as transaction ID, review content, and rating.
